question.worked_solution:
First, we isolate the ${a}^{2}$ on one side of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{a}^{2}-5}{3} & =0 \\ {a}^{2}-5 & =0 \\ {a}^{2} & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we take the square root of both sides of the equation and solve the resulting absolute value equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{{a}^{2}} & =\sqrt{5} \\ |a| & =\sqrt{5} \\ a & =\pm \sqrt{5}\end{aligned}
$$
